name: hotel-booking-management-system
description: Hotel Booking Management System - Full-Stack Web Application

scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd server && npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../server && npx prisma generate
